toggle_key.description: The key used to toggle effects on/off at runtime. Common keys: Home, Insert, End, Pause.

output_path.description: The destination file path for the generated configuration file.

cas_sharpness.description: Contrast Adaptive Sharpening sharpness level. Range: 0.0 to 1.0.

dls_sharpness.description: Deep Learning Sharpening sharpness level. Range: 0.0 to 1.0.

dls_denoise.description: Deep Learning Sharpening denoise level. Range: 0.0 to 1.0.

fxaa_subpixel_quality.description: FXAA subpixel quality factor. Higher values may look sharper but slower.

fxaa_quality_edge_threshold.description: FXAA quality edge threshold. Controls how much contrast is needed to trigger anti-aliasing.

smaa_edge_detection.description: SMAA edge detection method. 'luma' is generally preferred for performance, 'color' for accuracy.

smaa_max_search_steps.description: SMAA maximum search steps for edge detection.

smaa_max_search_steps_diagonal.description: SMAA maximum search steps for diagonal edges.

smaa_corner_rounding.description: SMAA corner rounding factor to prevent artifacts in corners.

lut_file_path.description: Path to the LUT file if 'lut' is in the effects list.

effects.description: List of active effects. Valid values: cas, dls, fxaa, smaa, lut.
